notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.6 fixes the rough edges found in a full review of the download flow. Asking for a video that is already downloaded now says so, in place, with Download again and Show in NDM — and shows the real state, including Retry, when the earlier copy failed. File downloads (ISOs, archives, programs) now get the same progress card videos always had, with the same pause and cancel. A video's total size is locked once its parts are measured, so the percentage no longer jumps mid-download, and the card now shows real phases — Preparing, then Receiving data, then Merging video + audio — instead of guessing. Duplicate 60fps labels are gone, estimated sizes are marked with a ~, the audio option no longer claims MP3 when the file is M4A, and Download all no longer counts files you already have as new downloads. Completion popups no longer stack up when several downloads finish in a row. The app also opens without the white flash, and update notes display in full.
